info.name: CYCLES_LIGHT_SOFT_FALLOFF
info.comment: Cycles vendor extension: soft falloff of point and spot lights with a radius. With 'softFalloff' enabled the light is evaluated like Cycles point lights with soft falloff (Blender's default) instead of as a sphere light, which only differs close to the light.

parameters.name: softFalloff
parameters.description: use the soft falloff of Cycles point lights instead of a sphere light

parameters.name: softFalloff
parameters.description: use the soft falloff of Cycles spot lights instead of a sphere light
